sources.label: Patches for apps I like for use with morphe.
sources.author: thebugsmith
patch_list: Replaces the signature-bound GMS Google Sign-In with a browser OAuth code flow (PKCE) against the app's own installed-app OAuth client so Google login works on a re-signed build.
Registers the OAuth redirect activity and its com.googleusercontent.apps intent filter so the browser-based Google login can receive the authorization code.
Unlocks premium features by bypassing Superwall paywall checks.
